from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        title = "Defining the PDE: The Multi-Variable Balance"
        lecture_lines = [
            "A PDE relates a function's partial derivatives together.",
            "Consider the heat equation: change over time equals curvature.",
            "The solution isn't one number, but a whole field.",
            "This field represents values across every point in space.",
            "We use special symbols to denote these partial changes."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Display "u(x, t)" in the center of the right side workspace.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)
        u_func = MathTex("u(x, t)", font_size=60)
        self.place_in_area(u_func, "A1", "F6")
        self.play(Write(u_func))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight "∂" in the Heat Equation #FFFF00.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Granular components for easy manipulation
        heat_eq = MathTex(
            r"\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}", "=", r"\alpha", r"\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}",
            font_size=48
        )
        self.place_in_area(heat_eq, "A1", "C6")
        
        partial_color = "#FFFF00"
        
        # Create colored version to transform into
        heat_eq_colored = heat_eq.copy()
        # set_color_by_tex on sub-objects
        heat_eq_colored[0].set_color_by_tex(r"\partial", partial_color)
        heat_eq_colored[3].set_color_by_tex(r"\partial", partial_color)
        heat_eq_colored[3].set_color_by_tex(r"\partial^2", partial_color)

        self.play(
            u_func.animate.scale(0.7).next_to(self.grid["F3"], UP, buff=0.5), # Reposition u_func
            Write(heat_eq)
        )
        self.play(Transform(heat_eq, heat_eq_colored))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Transform "u" into a surface of shifting colors.
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Representing "field" with a 2D grid of squares (avoiding 3D)
        grid_size = 6
        field_group = VGroup()
        for i in range(grid_size):
            for j in range(grid_size):
                sq = Square(side_length=0.4, stroke_width=1, fill_opacity=0.8)
                sq.set_fill(BLUE_E)
                field_group.add(sq)
        field_group.arrange_in_grid(rows=grid_size, buff=0.05)
        self.place_in_area(field_group, "D1", "F6")
        
        # Transforming the u_func into the field
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(u_func, field_group))
        
        # Shifting colors logic
        field_group.time = 0
        def field_updater(obj, dt):
            obj.time += dt
            for idx, item in enumerate(obj):
                # Harmonic oscillation across the grid
                color_val = (np.sin(obj.time * 1.5 + idx * 0.4) + 1) / 2
                item.set_fill(interpolate_color(BLUE_D, RED_D, color_val))
        
        field_group.add_updater(field_updater)
        self.wait(2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Underline the derivatives in the equation.
        self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # heat_eq[0] is \partial u / \partial t, heat_eq[3] is \partial^2 u / \partial x^2
        underline_lhs = Underline(heat_eq[0], color=WHITE, buff=0.1)
        underline_rhs = Underline(heat_eq[3], color=WHITE, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(
            Create(underline_lhs),
            Create(underline_rhs)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Flash the spatial derivative "∂²u/∂x²" with a glow #FF8C00.
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        spatial_derivative = heat_eq[3]
        glow_color = "#FF8C00"
        
        # Glow flash effect
        self.play(
            spatial_derivative.animate.set_color(glow_color).scale(1.2),
            Flash(spatial_derivative, color=glow_color, line_length=0.4),
            run_time=0.8
        )
        self.play(
            spatial_derivative.animate.scale(1/1.2).set_color(WHITE),
            run_time=0.5
        )
        # Restore the partial highlight colors
        self.play(
            spatial_derivative.animate.set_color_by_tex(r"\partial", partial_color),
            spatial_derivative.animate.set_color_by_tex(r"\partial^2", partial_color),
            run_time=0.5
        )

        self.wait(2)
        # Keep things on screen for the finish
        field_group.remove_updater(field_updater)
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *

class Section3Scene(Scene):
    """
    A robust Manim CE v0.19.0 scene visualizing the Heat Equation 
    as an introduction to Partial Differential Equations (PDEs).
    """
    def construct(self):
        # Title of the section
        title = Text("Introduction to PDEs", font_size=40, color=BLUE)
        title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        
        # The Heat Equation: A fundamental PDE example
        # u_t = alpha * u_xx
        heat_eq = MathTex(
            r"\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}", 
            "=", 
            r"\alpha", 
            r"\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}",
            font_size=54
        )
        
        # Descriptions for the terms
        time_derivative_label = Text("Change over time", font_size=24, color=YELLOW)
        time_derivative_label.next_to(heat_eq[0], DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        space_derivative_label = Text("Spatial distribution", font_size=24, color=GREEN)
        space_derivative_label.next_to(heat_eq[3], DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        arrows = VGroup(
            Arrow(time_derivative_label.get_top(), heat_eq[0].get_bottom(), buff=0.1, color=YELLOW),
            Arrow(space_derivative_label.get_top(), heat_eq[3].get_bottom(), buff=0.1, color=GREEN)
        )

        # Animation Sequence
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(Write(heat_eq))
        self.wait(1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(time_derivative_label, shift=UP),
            Create(arrows[0])
        )
        self.wait(0.5)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(space_derivative_label, shift=UP),
            Create(arrows[1])
        )
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Emphasis on the diffusion coefficient
        box = SurroundingRectangle(heat_eq[2], color=RED, buff=0.1)
        coeff_text = Text("Diffusion Coefficient", font_size=20, color=RED).next_to(box, UP)
        
        self.play(Create(box), Write(coeff_text))
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Fade out everything
        self.play(
            FadeOut(title),
            FadeOut(heat_eq),
            FadeOut(time_derivative_label),
            FadeOut(space_derivative_label),
            FadeOut(arrows),
            FadeOut(box),
            FadeOut(coeff_text)
        )
        self.wait(1)
